card.name: Punctuation inside eye exam and weakness lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of, comma, 'and', 'an', open parenthesis) right after a clinical term such as 'weakness', 'visual acuity' or 'BCVA', where a list or body-part phrase continues.

modes.description: 'and' or a letter piece in a pairing like AD and PDD.
